    <script>
      window.bus = {
        queue: {},
        cbs: {},
        on(event, cb) {
          if (!this.cbs[event]) this.cbs[event] = [];
          this.cbs[event].push(cb);
          if (this.queue[event]) {
            this.queue[event].forEach(e => cb(e));
          }
        },
        off(event, cb) {
          if (!this.cbs[event]) return;
          this.cbs[event] = this.cbs[event].filter(savedCb => savedCb !== cb);
        },
        emit(event, payload) {
          if (!this.queue[event]) this.queue[event] = [];
          this.queue[event].push(payload);
          if (this.cbs[event]) this.cbs[event].forEach(cb => cb(payload));
        }
      }
    </script>

one of the most critical sectors in mobile product design. The demand surged dramatically with the start of the pandemic in 2020 when safety concerns forced the mass cancellation of in-person appointments, driving an abrupt shift toward remote consultations. Today, with the global market value surpassing $300 billion and annual downloads exceeding 300 million, the competition is incredibly fierce. Apart from that, healthcare apps are considered to be among the most complex and challenging software products to build from a UX design perspective.       window.bus = {
        queue: {},
        cbs: {},
        on(event, cb) {
          if (!this.cbs[event]) this.cbs[event] = [];
          this.cbs[event].push(cb);
          if (this.queue[event]) {
            this.queue[event].forEach(e => cb(e));
          }
        },
        off(event, cb) {
          if (!this.cbs[event]) return;
          this.cbs[event] = this.cbs[event].filter(savedCb => savedCb !== cb);
        },
        emit(event, payload) {
          if (!this.queue[event]) this.queue[event] = [];
          this.queue[event].push(payload);
          if (this.cbs[event]) this.cbs[event].forEach(cb => cb(payload));
        }
      }

      window.bus = {
        queue: {},
        cbs: {},
        on(event, cb) {
          if (!this.cbs[event]) this.cbs[event] = [];
          this.cbs[event].push(cb);
          if (this.queue[event]) {
            this.queue[event].forEach(e => cb(e));
          }
        },
        off(event, cb) {
          if (!this.cbs[event]) return;
          this.cbs[event] = this.cbs[event].filter(savedCb => savedCb !== cb);
        },
        emit(event, payload) {
          if (!this.queue[event]) this.queue[event] = [];
          this.queue[event].push(payload);
          if (this.cbs[event]) this.cbs[event].forEach(cb => cb(payload));
        }
      }
    </script>
